summary: Builds a force-feedback output packet at this+0x938. Iterates 4 wheel blocks (stride 296 bytes from this+0x108) clamping each wheel type (value<24 -> value>>3 else 3), scaling the wheel force (read at v3-24) and an intensity (v3-20) by 7.0 and the force at v3+224 (this+0x1E8) by 15.0, and packing the results into a dword at this+0x938 and a word at this+0x93C. Packs steering/vibration bytes from this+0xC0, +0xAC, +0x98 scaled by 7.0/7.0/3.0 into this+0x93E. If the FFB enable flag at this+0x98C is set, iterates 17 channels from this+0x9A8, setting bitmask this+0x940 per active channel, packing two 4-bit intensity fields into this+0x93F, and clamping three force components to +/-511.98001 then scaling by 64.0 (saturating to +/-32767) into words this+0x944/+0x946/+0x948; otherwise zeroes this+0x93F/+0x940/+0x944/+0x946/+0x948. Returns this+0x938.

local_names.this: force-feedback controller object; output packet at +0x938..+0x948, enable flag at +0x98C, channel array at +0x9A8
local_names.v3: wheel-block base pointer, starts at this+264 and advances 296 bytes per wheel
local_names.v4: clamped wheel type (value >> 3, or 3 when the raw value is >= 24)
local_names.v9: 16-bit packing accumulator for the vibration/steering bytes
local_names.v10: 16 * v23[0] term used in the word packing
local_names.v11: FFB enable flag byte at this+2444 (this+0x98C)
local_names.v13: channel base pointer, starts at this+2472 (this+0x9A8) and advances 7 floats (28 bytes) per channel
local_names.v14: channel intensity byte A, clamped to max 15
local_names.v15: channel intensity byte B, clamped to max 15
local_names.v23: stack array of 6 words holding per-wheel CRTFtol results
local_names.v24: stack array of 4 dwords holding per-wheel packed values

operations.description: Four-iteration wheel loop: v3 starts at this+264 (this+0x108) and advances 296 bytes per wheel; per wheel a type, two force floats and one 15.0-scaled force are read.
Per-wheel type clamp: if the int at this+0x108 is < 24 the type is value >> 3, otherwise it becomes 3.

v5 = CRTFtol(wheelForce*7.0 + 0.5) + 8*v4; v6 = CRTFtol(wheelIntensity*7.0 + 0.5); v7 = (float at v3+224, this+0x1E8 on the first wheel) * 15.0. The wheel force and intensity floats at v3-24 and v3-20 have no field evidence.
v24[v2] = v6 + 8*v5 and v23[v2] = CRTFtol(v7 + 0.5), accumulating the per-wheel packed values in the two stack arrays.
Steering/vibration byte packing: v8 = (float at this+0xC0)*7.0, then three successive byte fields accumulate CRTFtol scales of this+0xC0, this+0xAC (7.0) and this+0x98 (3.0) with factors 8, 4 and 1.
Write the packed per-wheel dword to this+0x938: v24[3] + ((v24[2] + ((v24[1] + (v24[0] << 8)) << 8)) << 8).
Write the packed word to this+0x93C: v23[3] + 16*(v23[2] + 16*(v23[1] + 16*v23[0])).
Write the accumulated steering/vibration byte v9 into this+0x93E.
Branch on the FFB enable flag byte at this+0x98C (this+2444); if nonzero, pack the 17 channels, otherwise zero the FFB fields.
Enabled branch: initialize the channel bitmask this+0x940 to 0.
Seventeen-iteration channel loop: v13 starts at this+2472 (this+0x9A8) and advances 7 floats (28 bytes) per channel; the channel flag byte at v13-24 gates each channel.
Per-channel guard: if the channel flag byte at v13-24 is nonzero, the channel is packed.
Set bit v12 of the channel bitmask: this+0x940 |= 1 << v12 for each active channel.
Pack the two channel intensity bytes (v13-24, v13-23), each clamped to max 15, into this+0x93F = v15 + 16*v14.

For each of the three channel force components (v13-2, v13-1, *v13): if within +/-511.98001 multiply by 64.0, else saturate to 0x7FFF/-32767; write the three words to this+0x944, this+0x946, this+0x948. The two components at v13-2 and v13-1 have no field evidence; *v13 is the evidenced channel base this+0x9A8.
Enabled branch return: return this+0x938, the start of the FFB output packet.
Disabled branch: zero the FFB output fields this+0x93F, +0x940, +0x944, +0x946, +0x948.
Disabled branch return: return this+0x938, the start of the FFB output packet.
